META_TITLE: Envelope Budgeting — Give Every Dollar a Job | FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: FincWin's envelope budgeting gives every dollar a job across 14 categories and 5 frequencies — so you always know what's safe to spend. Free to start.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Real envelope budgeting: 14 categories, 5 frequencies, and a clear safe-to-spend number. Free, private, offline.
FEATURE_SUBHEAD: Assign your income to categories before you spend it. FincWin tracks each envelope so you always know what's left.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Spending categories tell you the past, not the plan
PROBLEM_BODY:
Most apps show you where money went after it's gone. That's a report, not a budget. By the time you see the overspend, it already happened.

Envelope budgeting flips it: you decide where each dollar goes first, then spend against the plan. FincWin keeps every envelope live as you go.
HOW_IT_WORKS:
• Set your income — your monthly take-home becomes the pool you assign from.
  • Create envelopes — Housing, Food, Transport, Subscriptions and more, across 14 categories.
  • Choose a frequency — weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly or yearly caps per envelope.
  • Spend against the plan — each envelope shows what's left in real time.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓14 categories covering every part of a real budget.
  • ✓5 frequencies — match caps to how your bills actually land.
  • ✓Safe-to-spend figure updated as you log expenses.
  • ✓Rollover control for envelopes you want to carry forward.
  • ✓Multi-currency — budget in any currency.
  • ✓Offline & private — data stays in your browser.
